objective: Test the bounded shared continuous-OI shortlist on a controlled nonlinear scalar target over the same frozen real-image embeddings, so nonlinear reference heads can contribute to the best-head envelope without changing images or backbone candidates.
scope: Post-linear-panel developmental stress test. This is not untouched confirmation and cannot establish external-dataset generalization.
dataset: Exact frozen 1,350-image UTKFace cohort and 16-backbone embedding bank from continuous_real_age_panel

target.rationale: A symmetric V-shaped transform around the exact midpoint of the frozen 0-89 age range; chosen before nonlinear outcomes.

backbones: Exact ordered 16-backbone roster inherited from the frozen embedding manifest
preprocessing: Exact row-L2 plus training-only randomized PCA-32 inherited from the linear real-image panel
reference_envelope: Maximum held-out R2 across the four unchanged nested-tuned head families
continuous_oi: Exact shared broad-RFF plus SAVE-RFF evaluator and bounded top-2k five-backbone rule inherited unchanged

bootstrap.unit: training cohort with shared evaluation cohort

decision_rule.primary: upper95 bounded-minus-linear-probe top-five mean utility regret <= 0
safety: broad top-one opportunity is preserved to absolute tolerance 1e-12
top-2k retrieval bound is active in every panel
all 20 panel-method rows are complete and finite
